subtitle: Hai Yen T'ang, Hall of Peaceful Seas · Xiyang Lou

model.line: Simple massing of a European palace, assumed: sizes from the texts and the ruin polygons, position from the plan or the ruin. Not a reading of the 1786 engravings yet.
rows: west block, two storeys, 11 bays on the west front (S109)
platform 1 m, eave 10 m, ridge 13 m above the ground

facts.label: English
facts.value: Hai Yen T'ang, Hall of Peaceful Seas

facts.label: Destroyed
facts.value: Looted and burnt 1860; stone ruins stayed, further damage 1900 and after (S02 pp.142,218)

facts.label: Bays
facts.value: 11 front (S06) in the texts / 1x3 on the plan

facts.label: Size in the inventory
facts.value: 19.0 × 44.0 m. typology xiyang_lou, B for tank, C for boxes

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Copper engraving no. 10-13 per S02. Plans Castiglione 郎世宁, fountains Benoist 蒋友仁 (S02 pp.139-140); also Attiret 王致诚 (S42;S56). Largest of the group, held the pumps and reservoir (S02 pp.148-155). Dimensions in S06 are in zhang.
